title: BREAD SPONGE
instructions: 6 potatoes , boiled and mashed fine while hot. 6 tablespoonfuls baker's yeast.  2 &#160; " &#160; white sugar.  2 &#160; " &#160; lard.  1 teaspoonful soda.  1 quart warm- not hot- water . 3 cups flour.   Mash the potatoes , and work in the lard and sugar. Stir to a cream, mixing in gradually a quart of the water in which the potatoes  were boiled, which should have been poured out to cool down to blood warmth,

Beat in the flour, already wet up with a little potato-water to prevent lumping, then the yeast, lastly the soda. Cover lightly if the weather is warm, more closely in winter, and set to rise over night in a warm place.
